newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Communications Inc says vp to leave.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Communications Inc says vp to leave.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc said on Tuesday that senior vice president of communications and policy planning, Robert Thomson, will leave his position on June 25.
TCI described Thomson's departure as a move reached "by mutual decision.

"We acknowledge and respect (Thomson's) decision to pursue other interests, and we wish him the best in his future endeavors," said Leo Hindery Jr., president and chief operating officer of the cable television company.
Thomson was not immediately available for comment.
